ingest.content_scope: author_original_post_only (replies excluded, never treated as author signals)

method_elements.summary: Compare a moving-average trend filter on leveraged index ETFs (LRS, Leverage Rotation Strategy) with a static leveraged stock/bond rebalanced portfolio (HFEA: UPRO + TMF).
method_elements.lrs_rule: Hold the leveraged ETF while the UNLEVERAGED index closes above its N-day simple moving average; otherwise hold Treasuries/cash.
method_elements.leverage_range_as_stated_by_author: best long-hold multiple roughly between 2x and 3x depending on index/period; inverse/short and >3x long funds not suited to long holding; narrow (non-broad) leveraged index funds cautioned
author_claims_unverified: QQQ-based leveraged long-hold could reach at least ~10x over 30 years (author's claim, NOT verified, not a MyAlpha result)
method_elements.verification_status: excerpt + #133 summary only; full-text method details must be re-read from the ingested source before the experiment is frozen

references_to_check_against_original.ref: Gayed & Bilello, Leverage for the Long Run (SSRN 2741701)
references_to_check_against_original.note: verify the original assumptions (index, MA length, financing, costs) rather than the forum paraphrase
HFEA is a separate risk-control comparator, not a default recommendation

variants.A: QQQM (or QQQ proxy before QQQM inception) buy & hold
variants.B: QLD long hold + annual rebalance to a pre-declared target weight against a pre-declared unleveraged/cash sleeve
variants.C: QLD while unleveraged NDX/QQQ close > MA200, else short Treasuries/cash
variants.E: TQQQ with MA200 and MA220 filters (two pre-declared runs)
variants.F: Read-only replay of the current MyAlpha TQQQ VIX/MA production strategy (no parameter changes)
variants.optional_control: HFEA (UPRO + non-leveraged/long Treasury sleeve) as an independent risk-control comparator

no_lookahead: signal = unleveraged index close vs MA computed on data up to that close
execution at the next tradable point (next session open or close, pre-declared), never the signal bar
exchange trading-day calendar; no holiday fills

synthetic_history.rule: before ETF inception, use daily-reset synthetic leverage of the total-return index
synthetic_history.label: synthetic samples are never reported as real ETF performance

anti_overfitting: MA200/MA220 are pre-declared; no post-hoc optimal window
walk-forward / out-of-sample split declared before running
threshold sensitivity grid reported in full (not just the best)
questions: Does an MA filter improve the risk/return of the current QLD annual-rebalance DCA leg?
Does it add genuine out-of-sample value relative to the existing TQQQ production rules (F)?
